director.name: 奥古斯托·扎诺维洛 Augusto Zanovello

introduction: A disoriented man, carried by two strangers, advances towards his destination: a village that recently emerged from the ground in South America... When he arrives, he will understand that his role in the village's life is essential.Miracasas takes you on a vibrant and colorful journey through the jungle, where the border between life and death is thin. The disoriented explorer in this film has a certain destination in a South American village. What or where this destination is will become clear, for both you and the explorer, if you just take the ride.
